newsitem.title: USA: Wyser-Pratte applauds Rexene, Huntsman talks.
newsitem.headline: Wyser-Pratte applauds Rexene, Huntsman talks.

text.p: Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg said Tuesday they were glad that acquisition discussions had begun between Rexene Corp and Huntsman Corp.
Both said they expect the Rexene board to make a good faith effort to reach an agreement for the acquisition of the company by Huntsman for $16 a share.

Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds, which have backed a change in Rexene's by-laws to make it easier to sell the company and replace the board, said they will resume their efforts to replace the Rexene board if negotiations do not reach a successful conclusion.
